summary: Neo and Morpheus fall from a helicopter, landing safely on a roof before the rope snaps taut and drags Neo to the edge. Trinity cuts the rope, causing the helicopter to smash into a skyscraper and explode. Neo pulls Trinity up onto the roof as they hold each other.
